Package hadur2.core.move

Class GunMimics

java.lang.Object
hadur2.core.move.GunMimics
public final class GunMimics extends Object
MOVE-27: an ensemble of enemy-gun models for the stop-point surf, after BeepBoop's (docs/bench/surf-b-rivals-read.md). Hadur's danger views mostly learn from the bullets that hit us; a learning gun learns from where we went on every wave. So beside the views this keeps a few mimics of common learning guns: classic visit-count buffers of guess factors, segmented from the shooter's side of the wave (flight time, lateral speed, acceleration, wall room, time since our last speed change) and each with its own rolling depth, from a flattener with no segments to a heavily segmented slow one.

Each model, the views included, is scored per opponent by how well it predicted the real bullets: at every bullet whose angle we learn (a hit, or one our bullet met), its probability in a window around that guess factor, relative to a uniform guess, is folded into a rolling mean. The blend weights the models by that score cubed, so a model counts only once it has beaten the others at real bullets. The views start well ahead, so the blend begins as the views.

Pure: it holds only its buffers and scores. Duel only, off unless the duel turns it on.
